arxiv-2307-00658.creator: Ben Perach Ronny Ronen Shahar Kvatinsky
arxiv-2307-00658.description: Abstract Online Analytical Processing (OLAP) for relational databases is a business decision support application. The application receives queries about the business database, usually requesting to summarize many database records, and produces few results. Existing OLAP requires transferring a large amount of data between the memory and the CPU, having a few operations per datum, and producing a small output.

arxiv-2403-01258.description: Abstract An increasing number of observations and simulations suggests that low-power (<10 44 erg s -1 ) jets may be a significant channel of feedback produced by active galactic nuclei (AGN), but little is known about their actual effect on their host galaxies from the observational point of view.

arxiv-2404-17081.description: Abstract . britannica-1911-hincks-sir-francis.description: Article 'Hincks, Sir Francis' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 13), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. was born at Cork, Ireland, the son of an Irish Presbyterian minister. In 1832 he engaged in business in Toronto, became a friend of Robert Baldwin, and in 1835 was chosen to examine the accounts of the Welland Canal, the management of which was being attacked by W. pmc-10673290.title: Design of a Circularly Polarized Micro-Strip Antenna for Aircraft Tracking Based on BeiDou III Compatible with Multi-Navigation System
pmc-10673290.creator: Zhenyang Ma, Xinyi Huang, Paulo M Mendes
pmc-10673290.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This paper proposed a right-handed circularly polarized (RHCP) micro-strip antenna for multi-navigation system applications. The size of the antenna is 70 mm × 70 mm × 2 mm, which is fabricated on an FR4 substrate. A meandering technique on a patch layer and asymmetrical defected ground structures (DGS) are employed to achieve the purpose of miniaturization and increase the bandwidth of the axial ratio.

pmc-11313625.title: Impact of Water–Cement Ratio on Concrete Mechanical Performance: Insights into Energy Evolution and Ultrasonic Wave Velocity
pmc-11313625.creator: Junzhi Lin, Bincheng Tian, Zelong Liang, Enpeng Hu, Zhaocun Liu, Kui Wang, Tao Sang, Miguel Bravo
pmc-11313625.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The water–cement ratio significantly affects the mechanical properties of concrete with changes in porosity serving as a key indicator of these properties, which are correlated with the ultrasonic wave velocity and energy evolution. This study conducts uniaxial compression tests on concrete with varying water–cement ratios, analyzing energy evolution and ultrasonic wave velocity variations during the pore compaction stage and comparing damage variables defined by dissipated energy and ultrasonic wave velocity. The results indicate the following findings.

pmc-11431017.title: Chemical Characterization and Temporal Variability of Pasta Condiment By-Products for Sustainable Waste Management
pmc-11431017.creator: Lorenzo Strani, Giulia Farioli, Marina Cocchi, Caterina Durante, Alessandra Olarini, Samuele Pellacani, Evandro Bona
pmc-11431017.description: Sustainable waste management is an extremely important issue due to its environmental, economic, and social impacts. Knowledge of the chemical composition of the waste produced is a starting point for its valorization. This research focuses, for the first time, on the by-products of pasta condiment production, starting with their characterization.

pmc-11504238.title: Aged Microplastics and Antibiotic Resistance Genes: A Review of Aging Effects on Their Interactions
pmc-11504238.creator: Kuok Ho Daniel Tang, Ronghua Li, Xuxiang Zhang, Anna Barra Caracciolo
pmc-11504238.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Microplastic aging affects the dynamics of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) on microplastics, yet no review presents the effects of microplastic aging on the associated ARGs. Objectives: This review, therefore, aims to discuss the effects of different types of microplastic aging, as well as the other pollutants on or around microplastics and the chemicals leached from microplastics, on the associated ARGs.

pmc-12505407.title: Impact of Digital Phenotypes and Question-Asking on Emotional Disorders in Adolescents: 4-Week Field Study
pmc-12505407.creator: Minseo Cho, Doeun Park, Myounglee Choo, Doug Hyun Han, Jinwoo Kim, Andre Kushniruk
pmc-12505407.description: BackgroundAdolescence is the period with the highest incidence of mental disorders, with approximately one-third, half, and two-thirds of cases emerging by ages 14, 18, and 25 years, respectively. Proactive interventions are essential, and digital phenotyping has emerged as a promising approach for timely detection and management.

pmc-12631553.title: Safeguarding microbial biodiversity: microbial conservation specialist group within the species survival commission of the International Union for Conservation of Nature
pmc-12631553.creator: Jack A Gilbert, Amber Hartman Scholz, Maria Gloria Dominguez Bello, Lise Korsten, Gabriele Berg, Brajesh K Singh, Antje Boetius, Fengping Wang, Chris Greening, Kelly Wrighton, Seth R Bordenstein, Janet Jansson, Jay T Lennon, Valeria Souza, Sarah M Allard, Torsten Thomas, Don Cowan, Thomas W Crowther
pmc-12631553.description: Harper, Louis-Patrick Haraoui, Suzanne L Ishaq, Margaret McFall-Ngai, Kent H Redford, Raquel Peixoto Published: 2025 Introduction Microorganisms—including microscopic single-cell and multicellular life—form the biological foundation of life on Earth. They regulate biogeochemical cycles, control climate-relevant gas fluxes, and underpin the health of all multicellular organisms (Cavicchioli et al. 2019, Lennon et al. 2023, 2024, Peixoto, 2024a) (Fig. 1A and B).

pmc-13114145.title: Phenotypic and Genomic Profiling of Escherichia coli from Irish Raw Milk and Raw Milk Products: A Baseline Study
pmc-13114145.creator: Deirdre M. Prendergast, Marian Teeling, Daniel Kelly, Saibh Healy, Gillian Madigan, Sinéad Murphy, Amalia Naranjo-Lucena, Montserrat Gutierrez
pmc-13114145.description: Background/Objectives: Escherichia coli is a ubiquitous commensal organism in humans, animals, and the environment, but certain strains harbour virulence and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) determinants that can cause significant disease. Food-producing animals, including dairy cattle, may act as reservoirs for AMR E. coli, and raw milk and raw milk products can serve as potential exposure pathways to humans.

pmc-13187189.title: Multimodal contrastive prognostication framework for early neurological outcome prediction in post-cardiac arrest patients
pmc-13187189.creator: Akhil Kasturi, Ashley R. Proctor, Ali Vosoughi, Chloe T. Zhang, Nathan Hadjiyski, Sydney V. Palka, Jenna Gonillo Davis, Lisa M. Cardamone, Samantha Helmy, Jeronimo Cardona, Thomas W. Johnson, Yang Gu, Mark A. Marinescu, Olga Selioutski, Regine Choe, Imad R. Khan, Axel Wismüller
pmc-13187189.description: Sudden cardiac arrest (SCA) remains a critical public health challenge with mortality rates close to 90%. Current prognostication methods commonly analyze data of individual modalities separately and delay assessment until 72 hours post-arrest, creating a critical gap in early decision-making.

pmc-13194839.title: Nano-Space Confinement Drives Rational Closed Pore Design in Hard Carbons for High-Capacity and High-Rate Sodium Storage
pmc-13194839.creator: Run Ren, Ling Zhang, Jianhua Zhu, Yunfeng Chao, Junlin Guo, Yijun Cao, Xiaobo Ji, Xinwei Cui
pmc-13194839.description: Highlights Nano-space confinement regulates heterogeneous nucleation of quasi-metallic Na clusters in closed graphitic pores of hard carbons, suggesting a coupled “intercalation-pore filling” and stage-wise storage mechanism for high Na-storage capacities.A new stage near the end of slope region was identified, where confined nano-spaces at 0.4–0.6 nm facilitate pre-desolvation and enhance Na-ion transport kinetics for high-rate capabilities.

pmc-13298049.title: Entropy Production from Spin–Vibrational Coupling in Endohedral-Fullerene Qubits Encapsulated in Suspended Carbon Nanotubes
pmc-13298049.creator: Cristian Staii
pmc-13298049.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Hybrid carbon nanotube–fullerene architectures provide a controllable setting in which to study irreversibility and information flow in strongly structured quantum environments. We analyze entropy generation in a platform where paramagnetic endohedral fullerenes (PEFs), such as N@C60 and P@C60, are encapsulated inside a suspended carbon nanotube (CNT) resonator, such that selected multi-level PEF spin states define an effective qubit coupled to quantized CNT flexural modes.

pmc-13319719.title: Time perspective status and associated factors among young and middle-aged women with gynecologic malignancies who have parenting responsibilities
pmc-13319719.creator: Guiyuan Ma, Cai Deng, Qiming Ding, Can Gu, Juan Peng

pmc-13546735.title: Digital Transformation in Pathology: A Digital‐First Model for Integrated Diagnostic Systems
pmc-13546735.creator: Hiroyuki Kusano, Takayuki Shiomi
pmc-13546735.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Digital pathology has rapidly expanded over the past decade, driven by advances in whole‐slide imaging and increasing demand for remote and data‐integrated diagnostic workflows. However, many implementations remain limited to partial digitization, without fundamentally transforming laboratory and diagnostic processes. In this review, we examine digital transformation in pathology as a systems‐level redesign encompassing workflow optimization, digital infrastructure, and networked diagnostic services.
